name: AnnualProductQualityReviewBuilder
tagline: APQR / PQR per product and site – section data, trends with Cpk, CAPA follow-up and QP approval in one app
description: Plug-and-play Power Apps component for pharmaceutical quality units: plan the yearly product quality reviews, request and track section data from QC, production, engineering and regulatory, evaluate batch trends with control charts and Cpk, record CAPA for adverse findings, run four-eyes QA review and QP approval, and carry open actions into the next review. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Configurable section template (EU GMP Chapter 1 topics by default)
Section owners, data due dates, bulk request / collected, N/A justification
Control charts with Cpk, OOS, 3σ and shift screening
Conclusion with revalidation decision and CAPA rule for adverse findings
Four-eyes QA review and independent approval with approval statements
Plan next review with carried-over actions
Undo, history, reminders and CSV export via Power Fx events
react: 16.14.0 bundled (no platform library, no Fluent UI)
controlType: standard (2 controls: niray_Niray.AnnualProductQualityReviewBuilder data-set + niray_Niray.AnnualProductQualityReviewBuilderPortal field control for Power Pages, shared src/app)
